messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty PDI-4821 triggered — automatic page fired for inference-gateway-prod-usw2: 5xx_rate spike (1m avg = 3.7%). See perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ingress/5xx?orgId=1

morgan: acked on-call (morgan) — taking lead. I'm checking region metrics and recent deploys.

jamal: saw a small deploy to canary ~5m ago to gateway sidecar (v2.14.1 -> v2.15.0). Canary was supposed to be isolated but routing fuzz might have bled. Looking at deploy logs now.

mei: tagging for triage steps from runbook: runbook/inference-gateway -> step 1 check k8s pod restarts, step 2 confirm KV cache hits, step 3 reroute to standby pool.

morgan: checked pods: no OOMs, but 6/120 gateway pods reporting 502s and elevated latency. `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide` shows pods in node group nvg-usw2-3 with high CPU.

oliver: customer-impact alert: some API keys are seeing increased 5xxs, but healthcheck uptime for Hosted is ~95% for the last 5m. Starting scoped customer check: product/oliver will call top-10 customers to prep.

kate: quick mitigation idea — shift a fraction of traffic off the strained node group and warm up reserve pool. Initiating traffic-slice reroute via router config.

morgan: executing traffic-slice command in control plane now: 
``` 
redwoodctl route update --slice inference-prod --weight nodegroup=standby:30 --reason "5xx spike - immediate relief"
```

pd-bot: PagerDuty note added by morgan: "Traffic slice + canary rollback check. Oncall investigating." Incident escalated to SRE TL (jamal).

jamal: while slice is propagating, I'm toggling proxy retry/backoff to be more aggressive to avoid thundering retries. Pushing quick patch to feature-flag: `ingress.retry_multiplier=0.5`

mei: seeing cache miss rate spike in KV cache. Possible cache warming problem after canary. If cache miss > 20% then per-token cost and latency spike. Running warmup on standby pools.

morgan: traffic slice in place — stepping down traffic to the affected nodegroup. Early telemetry shows 5xx_rate dropping to 1.2% in 30s. Continuing monitoring.

oliver: customer comms: SLO impact for some customers — preparing short notification. No major revenue customers confirmed yet, sending targeted ping to support.

kate: logs from a failing request (partial):
```
ERROR inference-gateway [2026-03-15T02:34:11Z] request_id=ab12 auth=ok upstream=10.2.3.45:504 "POST /v1/generate" 502 0.025s "kv:get timeout"
```

jamal: that kv timeout lines up. Looks like a backend dependency (kv-store) experienced elevated tail latency coincident with canary. Rolling back the canary on the affected nodegroup now.

morgan: rollback command issued: `deployctl rollback inference-gateway --tag v2.14.1 --scope nodegroup=nvg-usw2-3` — waiting for rollout.

pd-bot: PagerDuty update: morgan acknowledged and escalated. PDI-4821 assigned to jamal; severity remains Sev2.

mei: also enabling KV client circuit-breaker increments to avoid cascading failures: `kv.client.max_concurrency=8` and `kv.client.timeout_ms=1200` (temporary).

morgan: rollback finished across 6 pods; observed 5xx_rate fall further to 0.4% in the region. Recovered.

oliver: customer impact summary for the last 12m: partial degradation affecting ~0.6% of requests in prod-usw2; no data-loss, retries likely surfaced as higher latency. Drafting a short update to affected customers.

jamal: follow-ups: 1) postmortem task to root-cause KV latency regression during canary, 2) tighten canary isolation (force shadow traffic only), 3) add runbook step to check dependent kv tail latency before promoting canary.

kate: I'll open the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/internal/incidents/PDI-4821 and add timeline and commands.

morgan: closing loop — marking incident as mitigated in PagerDuty, keeping a follow-up ticket for postmortem. Great work team. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Incident PDI-4821 marked mitigated by morgan at 2026-03-15T02:37:22Z.
